limitations: Only approved metrics and copy carry values or text; everything else is withheld.
No composite score: score100 is null in V1 (no approved scoring method exists).
Straight-line distances only. Observed transactions are not counts of prospective buyers, and nothing here is a forecast.
Launched-but-unsold homes and pipeline homes are withheld until their local and release approvals exist, and are never added together.
No approved bedroom classification for this development: no bedroom-specific resale claims.
Rental contracts include renewals; they do not show occupancy, yield or tenant demand.
